The property to be sold is located in the BOROUGH of MIDDLESEX, County of MIDDLESEX and State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 328 HIGH STREET, MIDDLESEX, NJ 08846.
Tax Lot No. 14 FKA 14, 15 & 16 in Block No. 34
Dimension of Lot Approximately: 66.67 x 100
Nearest Cross Street: MARKET STREET (FORMERLY GRAND AVENUE)
BEGINNING AT A POINT IN THE EASERLY LINE OF HIGH STREET, SAID POINT BEING DISTANT 308.33 FEET SOUTHERLY ALONG THE SAME FROM ITS PRODUCED iNTERSECriON WITH THE SOUTHERLY LINE OF MARKET STREET (FORMERLY GRAND AVENUE) AND FROM SAID POINT RUNNING:
"THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION."
PRIOR LIENS/ENCUMBRANCES
SEWER OPEN PLUS PENALTY
$687.40
TOTAL AS OF September 26, 2025:
Good faith estimate of upset price: $525/262.30
The occupancy status of the property being foreclosed herein presently unknown.
Surplus Money: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
